translatorNotes: WISMO handling: the acronym has no German equivalent, so the natural phrase 'Wo ist meine Bestellung?' is used as the primary rendering. The acronym 'WISMO' is kept where the source leans on it (title, headings, quick-answer capsule, FAQ) with an inline gloss the first times it appears ('WISMO (von "Where Is My Order", also "Wo ist meine Bestellung?")'). English brand/URL slug and the article:section value kept unchanged.
Informal du used throughout, Standard German. No em-dashes anywhere; the source's comma-spliced appositive style kept with commas/colons.

Ecommerce glossary: order status -> Bestellstatus, support ticket -> Support-Ticket, deflection -> Vermeidung, helpdesk -> Helpdesk, carrier -> Zusteller, fulfillment -> Fulfillment, self service -> Self-Service, tracking -> Sendungsverfolgung. Brand names kept: Shopify, Gorgias, Zendesk, ShippyPro, eDesk.

Currency and numbers localized in prose while keeping figures exact: '$5 and $12' -> '5 und 12 US-Dollar', '$5 to $22' -> '5 bis 22 US-Dollar', '$15,000 to $60,000' -> '15.000 bis 60.000 US-Dollar', '3,000' -> '3.000', '$8 each' -> '8 US-Dollar', '$24,000 a month' -> '24.000 US-Dollar im Monat', '$1.84' -> '1,84 US-Dollar'.
